title: Advanced Environmental Journalism
description: A seminar that engages with people and communities impacted by climate change to document their experiences. Includes publishing, broadcasting and presenting the resulting stories with major media and cultural partners.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of WRIT 345, ES 355, ES 381 (if offered in the same topic).
Students who took WRIT 345 in January to April 2022 may repeat the course with permission of instructor.
